ja.description: r7床是正版。規定入力120 rpm・時間圧縮16倍で4周期、計算上{forward:.1f} mm進みます。実機の歩行実証ではありません。
captions:
{design}案・r7床是正版の連続歩行計算です。実機の映像ではありません。
入力120 rpmを規定し、16倍の時間圧縮で表示しています。

実寸の歯車・クランク・リンクがつながり、六脚の荷重足と戻り足が交代します。
同じ入力条件では512:1のB案はA・C案より遅く進みます。

空中ロッカーは中立復帰の表示仮定、12本のばねは座・線径・巻数を保持する手続き形状です。
元解析の独立ロッカー角nullは変更していません。

4周期の計算上の前進は{forward:.1f} mmです。実測距離ではありません。
風・実自己始動・実30 cm歩行は未確認、実機合格0のままです。

en.label: English
en.title: r7 {design} | Continuous walking simulation
en.subtitle: Floor-corrected CAD | Calculated visualization, not a physical test
en.conditions: Prescribed input 120 rpm | Time compression 16x | Reduction {ratio}:1 | 4 cycles
en.telemetry: Crank {phase:.1f} deg | Prescribed time {seconds:.1f} s | Calculated advance {forward:.1f} mm
en.method: Airborne rocker: neutral-return display assumption | Springs: fixed-wire procedural geometry
en.caution: Not wind or impact dynamics. Physical self-start and actual 30 cm walking remain unverified.
en.description: Floor-corrected r7. Four cycles at a prescribed 120 rpm input and 16x time compression give {forward:.1f} mm of calculated advance. This is not a physical walking test.
captions:
Design {design}: continuous walking calculation using floor-corrected r7 CAD, not physical footage.
Input is prescribed at 120 rpm and shown with 16x time compression.

The actual gears, crank and links move together as the six legs alternate support and recovery.
At the same input speed, design B's 512:1 reduction makes it slower than A and C.

Airborne rockers use an assumed neutral-return display rule. All twelve procedural springs retain their seats, wire diameter and turn count.
The original analysis's independent rocker angles remain null.

Four cycles give {forward:.1f} mm of calculated advance, not a measured distance.
Wind-driven self-start and physical 30 cm walking remain unverified. Qualified physical prototypes: zero.
